title: Orbital era structural materials and profiles

specimens.name: Graded lattice sandwich
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 1 ONLY. One short oblique cut through two face skins and a branching 3D lattice, inclined struts visibly packed more densely near one edge. No uniform honeycomb, foam or whole panel. PRESERVE THIS INPUT CELL EXACTLY.

specimens.name: Forked continuous-fibre transition
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 2 ONLY. One unperforated Y-shaped load-branching composite coupon; visible continuous fibre bundles curve from one strip into two narrow branches. No clevis, pin or rectangular coupon. PRESERVE THIS INPUT CELL EXACTLY.

specimens.name: Tailored-thickness stamping
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 3 ONLY. One shallow saddle-shaped alloy shell fragment with a readable exposed cut edge smoothly thickening toward one shoulder. No seam, doubler, L-bracket or whole cover. PRESERVE THIS INPUT CELL EXACTLY.

specimens.name: Three-lobed closed torsion spar
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 4 ONLY. Completely replace the current end face. Rounded triangular extrusion. Three equally large rounded bores arranged like a clover: ONE centered above, TWO side by side below. Solid central web and solid wall between every pair. All other material of the face is solid, including between the upper bore and the outer edge. Exactly THREE dark apertures total. Render the end almost straight-on with a short visible extrusion depth.

specimens.name: Laminated safety glass retaining tongue
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 1 ONLY. One broad transparent unmounted architectural laminated glass corner, still fully inside its cell. Widen the visible glass plane substantially. Show exactly two clear glass plies and a single thin flexible interlayer tongue curving freely beyond the cut edge. Background visible through the broad face. No frame, electrodes or full window. PRESERVE THIS ENLARGED INPUT CELL EXACTLY.

specimens.name: Omega expansion membrane
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 2 ONLY. One thin metal cross-section with exactly one symmetric unloaded open omega fold joining two flat wings, visible open space below fold. No tubular bellows or rubber seal. PRESERVE THIS INPUT CELL EXACTLY.

specimens.name: Undercut ceramic thermal wedge
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 3 ONLY. Redraw one pale matte solid ceramic insulation wedge, upside down to expose its foot. The foot is ONE raised male dovetail ridge, a narrow solid neck topped with a wider trapezoidal head. On the near cross-section its two opposite overhanging shoulders are silhouetted against the background, one on the left and one on the right. No slot, no recess in the foot, no hollow channel, no separate rail.

specimens.name: Robot grip window at panel edge
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 4 ONLY. Redraw one cutaway composite edge with integral recessed metal robot pickup. One clear rectangular through aperture. At the midpoint of its LEFT and RIGHT inner walls each has ONE broad rectangular machined jaw land standing proud into the aperture, two opposing flat faces, mirrored lead-in chamfers and flat stop steps. Darken the internal wall behind the lands to make these two solid steps readable by geometry. Leave open background between the lands. No gripper, no separate handle.
